Laboratory preparation of hydrogen. A flat-bottom flask contains zinc granules. A thistle funnel passes through the rubber bung, its stem dipping below the dilute acid. A delivery tube leads from the flask into a pneumatic trough filled with water, bubbling gas into an inverted gas jar. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Laboratory preparation of chlorine. A round-bottom flask on a tripod over a Bunsen burner. It contains MnO₂ and conc. HCl added via a thistle funnel. The delivery tube passes through two wash bottles: the first containing water, the second containing concentrated H₂SO₄. The final dry Cl₂ is collected by downward delivery into a gas jar. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
